what: Exhaustion routing conflicts for launcher failures
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says push/launcher failures must remain exit 4 STALLED, but also rewrites vendor_loop_ci_fix_exhausted to expect exit 3 ci-fix-exhausted after all launcher tiers fail. Implementers can either misroute launcher/health outages into main-agent code edits or make the planned tests fail.
suggested_fix: Make one contract. For the safer minimum-change path, keep launcher/push/no-tier failures on exit 4, only set the ready-log exhaustion flag after an actual code-fix attempt runs, and leave vendor_loop_ci_fix_exhausted asserting exit 4; otherwise remove the launcher-failure carveout everywhere.
